primary_paper: Marwood, Visser, Salamonsen and Dimitriadis 2009, Endocrinology 150(6):2915-2923, doi 10.1210/en.2008-1538, PMID 19213836
perturbation_used: recombinant IL-11; recombinant LIF; IL-11-neutralizing antibody; LIF antagonist; integrin-alpha2beta1 neutralizing antibody
proximal_measurement: pSTAT3 (abolished by either cytokine-specific blockade); integrin-alpha2 mRNA and protein by RT-PCR and antibody array
functional_measurement: adhesion to fibronectin and collagen IV; trophoblast attachment to endometrial epithelial cells
what_is_supported: IL-11 and LIF BOTH activate STAT3, BOTH increase adhesion to FN and COL4, and BOTH increase integrin-alpha2 mRNA and protein. A second GP130-family ligand therefore acts in human endometrial epithelium, so E_GP130_STAT3 = E_LIF is false. AND, more sharply than the review conveyed: the two ligands DISSOCIATE on phenotype -- "IL-11 stimulated, whereas LIF had no effect on the adhesion of trophoblast to endometrial epithelial cells".
what_is_NOT_supported: IL-11-dependent ACTIVE or REQUIRED alpha2beta1. The primary reports the NEGATIVE: "LIF but not IL-11 induced adhesion to collagen IV was reduced by an integrin-alpha2beta1 neutralizing antibody." Also NOT supported: that a convergent-only motif suffices -- the dissociation is DOWNSTREAM of both STAT3 and ITGA2, so a model in which both ligands feed one STAT3 node predicts interchangeability, which this contradicts.

Adds a line the review omitted: STAT3 inhibition reduced BOTH cytokines' fibronectin-adhesion responses, so the shared convergence node is demonstrated, not inferred; and the trophoblast assay used PRIMARY FIRST-TRIMESTER TROPHOBLAST, so the IL-11-only attachment effect is human-human. STILL OPEN: whether the alpha2beta1 negative for IL-11 is a powered negative, and the pSTAT3 timecourse.

primary_paper: Kusama et al. 2013, Placenta 34(3):212-221, doi 10.1016/j.placenta.2012.12.017, PMID 23352189
perturbation_used: PKA-selective cAMP analogue N6-Phe-cAMP; EPAC-selective analogue 8-CPT-2-OMe-cAMP; EPAC1, EPAC2 and RAP1 knockdown
functional_measurement: IGFBP-1 and PRL expression; morphological decidual differentiation
what_is_supported: cAMP acts through at least two intracellular effectors in human ESC and the decidual response REQUIRES both: EPAC1/EPAC2/RAP1 knockdown inhibits the PKA-driven IGFBP-1 and PRL response. cAMP is therefore NOT biologically equivalent to PKA. This SATISFIES the reopening condition recorded against IN_cAMP/S_PKA.
what_is_NOT_supported: An INDEPENDENT EPAC arm, and now also A BOOLEAN REPRESENTATION OF ANY KIND. Full text: the EPAC-selective analogue alone had no effect, and Epac1/Epac2/Rap1 knockdown 'SIGNIFICANTLY INHIBITED' rather than abolished the PKA-driven response. The arm is a GRADED POTENTIATOR, and a rate-free Boolean model cannot express potentiation. So no EPAC node should be added -- not because the biology is weak but because the model class cannot represent it. The requirement does hold under ovarian steroids, not only analogues.

what_is_supported: Enzyme state and cleavage-product state are experimentally DISSOCIABLE. primary_paper: Dominguez et al. 2010, PLOS One, doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0013380
species_system: human, primary endometrial epithelial cells; mouse blastocyst adhesion assay
perturbation_used: 48 h treatment of primary human EEC with hCG (100 U/ml), 17-beta-estradiol (30 nM), progesterone (1 uM), E2+P4, and separately IL-1beta, LIF (1000 U/ml), TGF-beta, NGF, EGF, IGF; lentiviral CD98hc overexpression; CD98-specific shRNA; CD9 overexpression and siRNA; JAR spheroids and their conditioned medium
proximal_measurement: flow cytometry of CD98 membrane expression (MFI, n = 4-6 independent primary cultures); Western blot of total lysates; confocal apical/basolateral localisation; co-immunoprecipitation with CD9, CD147, ICAM-1, beta1 and beta3 integrins; immunohistochemistry across the cycle
what_is_supported: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-17 (U4), confirming and sharpening the abstract-level reading. CD98 membrane expression in PRIMARY human EEC is significantly induced by hCG (p < 0.02; Western 4.4-fold), by 17-beta-estradiol (p < 0.00001; Western 2.8-fold), by E2+P4 (Western 3.5-fold) and by LIF (p < 0.02), and also by NGF and EGF. hCG is therefore a directly evidenced inducer for a rule variant, AND SO IS E2 -- which the repository had not recorded: it is the LARGEST effect in the panel. Functionally, CD98 overexpression gives near-100% mouse blastocyst adhesion at 24 h and CD98 shRNA significantly impairs it, so the node is not a marker. Two NEGATIVE results the repository also lacked: PROGESTERONE ALONE does not induce CD98 (Western 0.6, i.e. reduced), and TGF-beta significantly REDUCES it.
what_is_NOT_supported: That LIF is NOT an inducer. THIS CORRECTS THE REPOSITORY'S OWN COUPLING RATIONALE, which claimed the model 'asserts an inducer the evidence does not name and omits the one it does'. LIF IS among the named inducers; the defect is INCOMPLETENESS, not misattribution. REF-008's own key_use field already recorded all four inducers, so the correction was available locally all along. ON THE EMBRYO-CONDITIONED DISJUNCT, the full text REFINES the earlier 'no source read names one': the paper DOES report that JAR spheroids and their CONDITIONED MEDIUM induce membrane CD98, and that CD98 rises in the endometrial cells contacting a mouse blastocyst (Fig 4E). But the conditioned-medium result is 'DATA NOT SHOWN' and the authors attribute it to the hCG the spheroids secrete, explicitly ('because of their capacity to secrete significant amounts of chorionic gonadotropin'). No hCG-depleted or hCG-blocked conditioned medium was tested. So the source supports an embryo-conditioned ROUTE and does NOT support a GENERIC embryo-conditioned inducer DISTINCT FROM hCG -- which is the only thing TI001's third disjunct could add.
confidence: high -- FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-17 (PDF-047), superseding the earlier abstract-level verification
verification_route: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-17 in U4 from the local PDF library, registered already as PDF-047, reference already registered as REF-008. Supersedes the 2026-09-16 abstract verification, which was sufficient for the four-inducer claim and not for the embryo-conditioned one. STILL WANTED, and now specific: whether hCG-depleted embryo-conditioned medium still induces CD98, and the relative magnitude of hCG versus LIF induction.
canonical_promotion_decision: COUPLING RATIONALE CORRECTED in config/coupling_adjudication.tsv; the ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED verdict stands on the incompleteness ground. The structural probe CANNOT choose the inducer -- STAT3-or-hCG, STAT3-or-hCG-or-E2 and STAT3-or-generic-signal all give 35 -> 36 -- so the choice rests on evidence alone. U4 2026-09-17: NO CANONICAL PROMOTION. CD98-c now has the most direct evidence of any member of this family -- IN_HCG and IN_E2 are both measured inductions of membrane CD98 in primary human EEC in this one paper -- and it is still not enough. Note the third disjunct is NOT equally direct: this paper measures LIF, not STAT3 activity, so E_GP130_STAT3 rests on a two-paper chain through Marwood 2009's LIF -> pSTAT3, and NO source tests whether the LIF induction of CD98 is STAT3-dependent. And: the induction is GRADED (1.2-1.5 fold MFI) against a non-zero baseline, so 'or' asserts a sufficiency the data do not show, and competing variants remain plausible -- section 5's stated consequence is a rule_variants FAMILY, not a network fact. primary_paper: Yap / Dimitriadis et al. 2011, Reprod Biol Endocrinol 9:73, doi 10.1186/1477-7827-9-73, PMID 21619711
species_system: human; primary endometrial epithelial cells (hEEC) AND two carcinoma lines (ECC-1, Ishikawa); plus human endometrial biopsies across the cycle (n = 6-8 per phase)
perturbation_used: recombinant IL-11 100 ng/ml (and 500 ng/ml for Western validation), 24 h. NO LIF ARM AND NO OTHER COMPARATOR CYTOKINE.
proximal_measurement: 2D-DIGE of the purified membrane fraction (866 spots; 13 significantly altered; 4 excised, 20 proteins identified by LC-MS/MS, each spot a mixture); Western blot of membrane and total fractions; immunocytochemistry; immunohistochemistry across the menstrual cycle
functional_measurement: NONE. No adhesion, attachment, trophoblast or blastocyst endpoint is performed anywhere in the paper; the adhesive phenotype is cited from the authors' earlier work (ref 15 = Marwood 2009).
what_is_supported: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-17 (U4). IL-11 raises TWO plasma-membrane proteins in human endometrial epithelium: ANNEXIN A2 (ANXA2; DIGE spot 9, fold 1.33, p 0.02; membrane Western 2-fold ECC-1 and 2.5-fold Ishikawa, both p <= 0.05; stronger surface immunostaining in primary hEEC and ECC-1) and FLOTILLIN-1 (FLOT1; spot 14, fold 1.40, p 0.04; membrane Western 1.8-fold ECC-1, 2.3/2.4-fold Ishikawa). Independently of IL-11, FLOT1 immunostaining in glandular epithelium is maximal in the mid-secretory phase (p <= 0.0001), i.e. in the receptive window.
what_is_NOT_supported: THE CLAIM THIS PAPER WAS READ TO DECIDE: that either protein is an IL-11-SPECIFIC executor of the trophoblast-attachment effect LIF lacks. The study runs NO LIF COMPARATOR, so nothing in it can be attributed to IL-11 rather than to GP130/STAT3 in general, and it runs NO FUNCTIONAL ENDPOINT, so neither protein is shown to execute anything. It is also ABUNDANCE, not activity -- the DRE009 failure mode. Two further limits, stated by the authors: in PRIMARY hEEC neither protein's TOTAL abundance changes, the ANXA2 membrane difference is described as apparent and is not quantified, and the authors state they were unable to detect FLOT1 in primary hEEC by Western -- so EVERY quantified fold-change is in a carcinoma line; and the paper's own conclusion is that IL-11 'MAY regulate ... at least in part via these proteins' and that their role in adhesion 'REMAINS TO BE ELUCIDATED'.
confidence: high for what it reports; the question it was read to answer is ANSWERED NEGATIVELY -- the discriminating comparison is absent, not unfavourable
verification_route: FULL TEXT READ 2026-09-17 in U4, from the local PDF library (context/literature/pdfs/, gitignored), 15 pages, sha256 307076c46158b12a25f1cd3e103be6d6477bcc8586449b229236ed042b3241da. NOT registered in pdf_manifest.tsv and no ref_id assigned: registration accompanies a promotion and nothing is promoted on this paper. STILL WANTED: the same proteomics with a LIF arm, and an attachment endpoint under ANXA2 or FLOT1 knockdown.
canonical_promotion_decision: NO PROMOTION, AND THE RULE FAMILY IS NOT COLLAPSED. This was the item most likely to decide whether TI002's family reduces to one member. It does not: it supplies two CANDIDATE executors and neither is shown to be IL-11-specific or functional. The tempting move is concrete and is refused -- ANXA2 is already the committed node E_ANXA2_ACTIN, so 'E_ANXA2_ACTIN = E_SECRETORY_STATE or X_IL11' would write the second family member AND break it out of the nine-member AC01 class in one edit. Writing it would invent the functional link, which GP130-b's own limitation column already forbids. The family is therefore SINGLE-MEMBERED FOR WANT OF A REPRESENTABLE ALTERNATIVE, not because the evidence chose. See docs/v05_u4_gp130_axis.md.
